6. `git status --porcelain` — my edits are exactly `Shell.tsx` + `tokens.css`; `AgentTerminal.css` needed no change (its `--app-content-left` reads were already vault-agnostic). Repo also shows extensive unrelated diffs from landed Waves 1-2 and a separate concurrent automations goal-skill run — not touched by me.

**`readStoredPage` restructuring:** now takes `(vault, instanceId)`, called from a `useState(() => readStoredPage(vault, instanceId))` lazy initializer with `vault`/`instanceId` sourced from `useVault()`. Precedence unchanged: `/lab/` deep-link (gated `instanceId === 'inst-1'`) → `?page=` → stored → `'tasks'`. Switched the stored-page read/write from `localStorage` directly to `readScopedRaw`/`writeScopedRaw` (raw layer, not JSON) — the value has always been a bare page string, and the JSON layer would fail `JSON.parse('tasks')`-style values on migration for every page except literally `"tasks"`.

**Stopped on:** `ProjectInstance.tsx:151,189` — `Shell` now requires `sidebarCollapsed`/`onToggleSidebar` props, but `ProjectInstance` destructures only `{ vault, instanceId, isActive }` and doesn't forward them to `<Shell>`. Per your note, I did not touch that file — it needs `{ vault, instanceId, isActive, sidebarCollapsed, onToggleSidebar }` destructured and passed through to `<Shell sidebarCollapsed={sidebarCollapsed} onToggleSidebar={onToggleSidebar}>`.
